requires.degrade: Without node, /prototype:explore-directions and /prototype:pressure-test cannot run the medium resolver: each says so in one line and keeps its shipped default, and pressure-test's audience routing still picks the shell.
Without Python 3, /prototype:explore-directions cannot serve the mockup's notes host, so notes stay in the page's copy-out control and the file:// mockup works as before.
Without curl, the notes host's session watcher does not start, so notes stay in the page's copy-out control and the file:// mockup works as before.
